dmn_experiences.title: Nottingham Beer Tasting Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided walking tour of at least three of Nottingham's craft beer venues, with a tutored tasting at each stop. A local guide talks through the beer styles and the city's brewing history.
highlights: Tutored tastings at three or more venues
Stops including Crafty Crow and Organ Grinder
Led by a knowledgeable local guide

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Fizzics Bubble Bar + Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A one-hour session at The Alchemist Nottingham where guests build a bubble bar to take home and make the venue's signature Raspberry Ripple gin and fizz cocktail.
highlights: Make a personalised bubble bar to take home
Mini-masterclass on the Raspberry Ripple cocktail

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A cocktail masterclass at Das Kino in the Lace Market, where an in-house expert guides groups through making two cocktails alongside games and prizes. It runs on Saturdays for groups of six to 15.
highlights: Make two cocktails with an expert
At least four games with shots and prizes
